I read the rationale and made some suggested wording changes. Two larger asks: 

1) External comms paragraph for customers: I propose we lead with stability and partner support vs. the word "pause." Suggested sentence: "Through Q4 we are prioritizing platform stability and partner success; we will complete select feature work only where it directly improves reliability or customer economic outcomes."

2) For the internal org message, include a short FAQ (2 bullets) that addresses headcount timelines and hiring criteria — it will reduce follow-up. I drafted two FAQ bullets at the end of the doc.

Below is my suggested external paragraph (feel free to lift into the doc):

---
Suggested external paragraph for customers:
"As part of our Q4 focus, Redwood will concentrate engineering capacity on improving uptime, lowering inference unit cost, and reducing tail latency for production workloads. This temporary focus will not change our integration commitments; your dedicated support contacts remain the same and will coordinate any timeline-sensitive milestones."
---
